note: docs/141 §7 candidate-loop A/B, arm OFF: the game's candidate loops (all three switches at their tuning default, off). ts3native 0.36.13 (game-copy/ts3native.asi.0313, as freeze-fix-ab) with ts3fixes built from the commit that adds CandidateLoops.cs installed. All arms: FallbackAsync=1, SyncCapMs=0, LogFallbackMs=20, LogFallbackStack=16 (deep enough to see the caller below our hook frames). Repro candidate-loops runs the probe (front door, farthest lot, indoor positions for the selected Sim) twice at the window start, then 10 min of play. Pass = no crash, game alive, fbActiveTrip 0, watchdogs 0. Read: the probe lines (farthest lot id must match across arms; ms per loop), patches safespotcap_* / farthest_* / indoorcap_* / routablecache_*, sync plan lines whose stack has FindRoutablePointInsideNearFrontDoor, IsPointInLotSafelyRoutable, GetFarthestLot or GetRoutableIndoorPositions (count, max ms), stuck Sims vs OFF.
